'''Rei Sakuma''' (Japanese: '''佐久間レイ''' ''Sakuma Rei''), born '''Reiko Sakuma''' (Japanese: '''佐久間玲子''' ''Sakuma Reiko''), is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Sakuma was born as Reiko Sakuma on January 5, 1965, in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. She joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|OS}} and voiced {{an|Daisy}}, one of {{an|Misty}}'s [[Sensational Sisters|older sisters]]; and [[Suzie]], a famous {{tc|Pokémon Breeder}} and {{pkmn|groomer}}. She then returned during {{aniseries|XY}}, voicing [[Pokémon Showcase]] producer [[Palermo]]. Sakuma is currently affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|81 Produce}}.
